evidence: ATTRIBUTION_GAP: Properties.exterior (NavierStokes/LocalPaperTheorem.lean:79-83) asserts only A w = 0, D w = BaseExterior.heatVelocity C h w, p w = BaseExterior.heatPressureField C h w and zero residual; the paper's expressions appear in Properties.exterior_radial_form / exterior_amplitude_formula / exterior_heat_equation / exterior_profile_smooth / exterior_profile_derivatives_bounded, NavierStokes/LocalPaperHeat.lean:22-72.

NavierStokes.LocalPaper.local_theorem is an unconditional existential whose Properties structure carries clauses (i)-(iv) for one tuple (A, D, u, p): decomposition u = curl A + D with D = B e_θ for an axisymmetric B, exact divergence-freeness, Cartesian smoothness including the axis, scale-strip jet bounds plus genuine one-sided extensions, all-order residual flatness uniform on 0 ≤ X ≤ X_1 as q ↓ 0, the zero-residual heat exterior, and the (3.6) ray asymptotic. Every definition it uses matches the paper's (q solves q - z²q^{2h} = τ; X = r²/2q; R = ∂_t u + (u·∇)u - Δu + ∇p; A = 1/2 + h). It is stronger on the domain, on c', on the extensions and on the exponent. The only gap is packaging: the explicit (3.5) formulas sit in five companion theorems.

findings.summary: The literal (3.5) formulas (K = r^{-1-2h}H_ext(τ/r²), H_ext smooth with bounded derivatives, p = -∫_r^∞ K²/ρ, the radial heat equation) are not inside local_theorem; five companion theorems supply them from a Properties hypothesis.
